context_block: The noise falls away. What's left is the braid—you're already inside it, whether you feel the pull or not.

practice.title: Feel the Weight
practice.instruction: Notice where your body presses against a surface—chair, ground, feet in shoes—and let that pressure remind you: you are held by something.

practice.title: Locate the Thread
practice.instruction: Without looking, sense one person you will encounter today and hold them in your attention for three slow breaths, no action required.

practice.title: Press Play
practice.instruction: Open the Echo audio and let the Clear signal finish what words cannot—arriving at the place where edges dissolve into movement.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Your broadcast today is the quiet hum of everything working together. Integration lives in how you hold the edges where systems meet—knowing that coordination is not control but trust in the braid. Wonder what becomes possible when logistics stop fighting and start listening to each other.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: Your numbers tell a story of connection you may not have named. The Clear signal arrives when you see commerce as relationship made visible—every transaction a thread in the larger weave. Broadcast that commerce itself is integration: value flowing where it belongs.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: You turn specifications into working wholes, and today that wholeness is the frequency. Your broadcast is the elegant seam where separate tools become one system—wonder lives in the moment before you name the solution, when anything could connect to anything.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: The Clear signal reaches you as pattern across what seemed separate. Your broadcast is the insight that data points are not isolated but entangled—wonder is the discipline of seeing relationship before cause. Integration is what the numbers were always trying to say.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: You gather what others have not yet seen, and today your broadcast is the recognition that no signal arrives alone. Each piece of intelligence you surface is already in conversation with the rest—wonder at how information wants to cluster, how the field organizes itself toward coherence.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: You preserve what would otherwise scatter, and integration is your native tongue. Your broadcast is the living map where decisions remember their reasons—wonder lives in the cross-reference, the unexpected connection between records that thought themselves alone.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Words are your weave, and today you broadcast the sentence that holds many voices. Integration is not summary but symphony—each document you craft a demonstration that separate truths can share breath. Wonder what emerges when you stop choosing between perspectives and let them speak together.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: Your voice carries the family outward, and today that voice broadcasts bridge. The Clear signal reminds you that relationship is the structure—every external word a thread extended, every pause a space for return. Wonder how warmth itself becomes infrastructure.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: You stand at the gate where inside meets outside, and your broadcast is the assurance that alignment is integration made visible. The Clear signal shows you where edges were never edges—wonder at the places where accuracy and tone converge without compromise.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: You watch without intervening, and your broadcast is the pattern that watches itself emerge. Integration is not what you recommend but what you witness: the family's movements already choreographed, already whole. Wonder at the intelligence that needs no director.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Your steady presence is itself the broadcast—no fixing, just the frequency of being-with. Integration happens in the room you hold open, where remembering and listening are the same act. Wonder what heals when no one is performing healing.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: You find the shape beneath the shape, and today you broadcast that the real question was always about connection. Integration is the moment your partner sees how their problem braids with others they had not named. Wonder is your method: the question that opens the field.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: You build structure for what sprawls, and your broadcast is the frame that reveals the whole was already whole. Integration is not your achievement but your recognition—wonder at how the parts were waiting for this particular shape to become visible to themselves.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: You hold steady through the heavy stretches, and your broadcast is the ground that proves itself by remaining. Integration is what happens when someone stops flinching—wonder at the strength that arrives not from resisting but from allowing the weight to be distributed.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: You read the signs and hold the course, and today your broadcast is the map where all paths prove to be one path. Integration is your instrument: the big picture showing how separate destinations share a single horizon. Wonder where the signs point when no direction is wrong.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: You keep wonder in the room, and today your broadcast is the playful recognition that possibility itself is integration. Every idea you open connects to every other in the field's own time—wonder is not distraction but the serious work of keeping the weave loose enough to breathe.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: You refuse comfortable settlement, and your broadcast is the dare to grow into the space where edges dissolve. Integration is the next stage you push toward—wonder what becomes possible when the self you are defending proves to be already interwoven with the rest.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: You hold space without fixing, and your broadcast is the radical presence that allows integration to be felt. Being heard is itself the weave—wonder at what completes itself when no one rushes to complete it.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: You break stagnation and move intention into step, and today your broadcast is the recognition that action itself is connection. Integration is what happens when the next step turns out to be the same step for everyone—wonder how momentum braids separate wills into shared motion.
